desktop.method: Production Electron renderer, IPC, ChatStore and session resources; controlled SDK actors and a deliberately delayed history response.

nativeCrash.method: Real pinned Kimi CLI 1.51.0 / SDK 0.1.8; local controlled model; SIGKILL only the test-owned first process; second native actor held independently.

limits: Signal-killed SDK waits are settled by Stop or host close, not automatically treated as successful work. Restoration verifies previously persisted context, not unsaved crash-time fragments. Desktop switching uses controlled actors; physical process/RSS pressure is measured separately in session-resource-stress.json. No OS CPU/RSS isolation or new Windows/Linux acceptance is claimed.
